Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Türkiye formally adopts new name as part of official country branding strategy Source : Kareen Tei 17 November 2026 5:47pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
The Government of Türkiye has formally adopted the name “Türkiye” as part of its official country branding strategy, prompting the Government of Ghana to direct public institutions and media organisations to reflect the change in their communications.
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs, in a public announcement on November 17, said the Embassy of the Republic of Türkiye in Accra had formally requested Ghana to adopt and use “Republic of Türkiye” as the country's official name.
The request follows Türkiye's decision to use the name as part of efforts to establish a consistent national identity and country branding.
In response, the Ministry has asked all Ministries, Departments and Agencies (MDAs), public institutions, organisations and other relevant stakeholders to replace “Republic of Turkey” with “Republic of Türkiye” in their official correspondence, publications, reports and other communications.
“The Government of the Republic of Türkiye has formally adopted the name ‘Türkiye’ as part of its official country branding strategy,” the Ministry stated.
Media organisations have also been urged to take note of the updated designation and ensure it is reflected in their news reports, broadcasts, publications and other media engagements.
The Ministry emphasised the need for consistency in the use of the country's official name and called on all stakeholders to cooperate in implementing the directive.
“The Ministry counts on the cooperation of all stakeholders in ensuring the consistent use of the official name of the ‘Republic of Türkiye’,” it said.
The directive means that Ghanaian public institutions and media houses are expected to use Türkiye in place of Turkey in their official communications and coverage.
